title: captain's board layout parity with the 2026-09-20 prototype
acceptance: Captain decision D-047 chose option B: full layout parity with design/proposals/2026-09-20-captain-board/prototype.html, without invented percentages. This task's own entry must be committed into design/tasks.json and its row added to design/design.md's task table on this task's branch.

Header engine badge per settled decision V7: show the top-level vendor from config.yaml and, when config.yaml's reviewer vendor differs, mark it (for example 'claude ⇄ cursor-agent'). Read config.yaml at request time; never hard-code vendor names.
Counts add a 'waiting on you' figure equal to the number of pending decisions, beside merged, in flight, blocked and queued.

Progress lanes render as six columns left to right in lifecycle order: queued, work, gate, review, captain, merged. Merged is a lane; closed tasks stay in the collapsed history T-034 established. Cards show task id and title, the aboard crew name when one is assigned, the PR number, 'blocked on T-xxx' for queued tasks with unmerged dependencies, and badges derived only from real events (for example the failing gate number, ASK-PASS-CRITERIA, or a pending decision's option count). A task absent from design/tasks.json shows its id with an explicit missing-title label, never an invented title.

The merge-refused feedback (board/public/index.html render(): latest response with merged.ok === false) must clear once that decision's task or PR later records a merged event, and while shown it must name the decision id and task. A failed merge that was superseded by a successful merge of the same task must never keep displaying.

Crew roster uses the prototype's two-column rows: status dot, crew name, stage pill, PR number, task id and title, and authored activity. A progress bar appears only when the crew payload carries bounded {done,total} progress (T-036). No percentage is shown otherwise.

Decision area follows the prototype: a captain portrait panel beside the first full pending decision card; further pending decisions collapse to one-line strips that expand in place. Preserve T-034's two-stage select-then-confirm, the custom response, the authored diagram embed, and links to the local file, PR and design.md where the data exists.

Ship and deck follow the prototype: a two-mast ship, crew name tags above heads (no percentages), a roster toggle and the AHOY demonstration, and drag/rotate/double-click-reset deck interaction. Keep T-034's invariants: exactly one captain always aboard, the helm at the left firstmate anchor, bow left and stern right, reduced-motion and mute behaviour.
The live log moves to a full-width panel at the bottom as in the prototype.

The prototype's crew percentages (100% / 91% / 73%) and its random pct tick are demo-only and must not ship anywhere (T-036). Dynamic summaries stay en plus zh-TW with zh-CN derived through i18n/tw2cn.tsv; extend that table for any new interface text so zh-CN renders fully simplified.
Layout holds at 320, 390, 768 and 1280 px widths and 200 percent text in all three locales without page overflow, per T-034.

Add fail-first tests: tests/board.test.sh for the API (engine badge data from config.yaml, waiting-on-you count, merge-refused clearing after a later merged event, lane order and dependency blocking), and browser tests for the six-lane order, header badge, banner clearing, and no progress bar without bounded progress. Evidence is the pull request's required GitHub check and the seven gates.
Stay inside this scope. If the work needs a file outside it, stop and name the file and the reason instead of editing it.
